correctness.rationale: The exact conditional-first splitting identity follows from removing a chosen site and its neighbors; the unconditional recurrence gives a verified generating function. An explicitly derived signed integral remainder is positive, strictly decreasing in magnitude, and has a factorial upper bound. All parity cases, exceptional n=1,2,4 and the delicate a odd, b even case are proved using strict integral ratios; a=0 is treated separately. A standard-library script independently compared exact rational recursion against direct permutation enumeration on paths n<=8 (44 comparisons) and signs and bounds n<=100 (5,050 comparisons). The all-n claim relies on the analytic sign proof, not finite checks.

value.rationale: The sign of a local arrival-priority intervention on a one-dimensional hard-core adsorption process need not have a fixed direction: it alternates with endpoint distance across every path except three exceptional sizes. The exact sign table and factorial boundary localization identify how kinetic priority propagates into terminal jamming, adding a qualitative sensitivity theorem not provided by the classical mean coverage formula. This is an all-size and all-site classification, not a single finite example or raw recomputation.
